facts.fact: Kay 打哈欠打到能看见喉咙深处，说那是肚子里孩子在要休息，问话只能留到周一
Kay 说 La Dorada 的老板 Andy Rasmussen 在当地像镇长，会尽力帮忙
facts.anchor: Andy Rasmussen, is like the town mayor around these parts.

facts.fact: 叙述者私下谢 Kay 腹中胎儿，因为她八点还要赶去 Luke 订的餐厅
facts.anchor: I still had to change and get myself to the restaurant

facts.fact: 叙述者为赴约要不要换衣服纠结了半小时
facts.anchor: I spent a good half hour dithering over whether I should change

facts.fact: 叙述者下楼想去书房，转身撞见 Kenji 背对壁炉端着杯子
facts.anchor: was confronted by Kenji Nakamura standing with his back to the fireplace

facts.fact: Kenji 说那幅画画的不是圣母子，画里的婴儿是 Mary
facts.anchor: but it’s actually a Virgin and mother. That’s right, Mary’s the baby.

facts.fact: Kenji 说 Sam 也有秘密，让叙述者再去问 Sam 当年劫持案究竟出了什么事
facts.anchor: make sure you talk to Sam again

facts.fact: Kenji 说自己要住 La Dorada，还打趣说明早可能死在这片乐园里
facts.anchor: Maybe I’ll end up dead in this Edenic paradise here

facts.fact: 叙述者排除 Luke 是 Eli 的可能：他五十岁，年龄整整大十岁
facts.anchor: Luke was not Eli. At fifty, he was a decade too old.
